faq: How do I book a Majestic tour?
Call the tour line on (242) 677-2600, email transport@majesticholidays.com, or visit the Majestic Tours desk in the lobby of your hotel.
Do tours include a hotel pickup?
It depends on the tour. The Fantastic Exuma Day Trip includes the hotel transfer; the Flying Cloud evening dinner sail does not. Each tour lists it.
How far ahead should I book an airport transfer?
Majestic asks that transportation bookings are finalised at least 5 days in advance, and accessible transport at least 48 hours in advance.
Do I clear US Immigration in Nassau?
Yes. Flights to the United States clear US Immigration and Customs in Nassau, and Majestic's departure pickup times allow for the extra time.
Which languages do your representatives speak?
Besides English: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Swiss German.

findings: The footer still says 2012-2021, and the homepage shows no phone number or email.
Every tour page sends guests to info@majestictourbahamas.com, which is missing an "s": those emails probably never arrive.
Two pages list different hotel desks and different extensions, so guests cannot tell which is current.
37 excursions sit in one alphabetical list, with no way to filter by island, evening or family.
The 1959 founding by Bill and Iris Saunders and five industry awards are hidden on the About page.
improvements: A first screen that says who you are, since when, and gives the tour line in one tap.
An illustrated chart of where each trip goes: tap Rose Island or the Exumas and see every tour there.
A filterable excursion index by type of day and destination, with each tour's own photograph.
A clear arrival guide for shared, private and accessible transfers, the way guests actually experience it.
One enquiry form that writes the email for the guest, plus full local search markup for 'Nassau tours'.
